purpose: Replace the manually maintained continuity snapshot with a deterministic compact projection that lets fresh parents/workers recover exact durable pointers and current operational frontier without transcript dependence.

continuity_head_is: a derived pointer/projection over durable source objects
continuity_head_is_not: an editable replacement for campaign, queue, run or return source truth
authority_boundary.truth_rule: Source objects and their authority planes remain authoritative. Counters, summaries, queue states and frontier text are recomputed projections and must never override conflicting source evidence.

compiler_inputs: project/root registry and bound Chat Objects
Opportunity Queue intents and derived eligibility
Product Memory/Canon/Working Set heads when canonical
authority/current/served refs needed for safe recovery

output_contract.source_identity: Every compilation records exact source refs plus enough head/digest identity to detect a projection built from mixed or stale inputs.
output_contract.compactness: The head contains pointers, derived summaries and small recovery-critical facts only. Large memory, returns, transcripts or private payloads stay behind referenced sources.
output_contract.ordering: Lists and summaries use deterministic ordering rules so identical durable inputs produce byte-stable or semantically stable output modulo declared compiled_at metadata.

root_projection.rule: A registered/discovered root is not silently treated as bound. Root membership does not confer product authority.

campaign_projection.derivation: Counts are reconstructed from durable source objects on each compile. Snapshot counters from an older head are never incrementally trusted as source truth.

execution_semantics: claim without durable STARTED is distinguishable from active execution.
RETURN without terminal DONE remains RETURNED_NOT_TERMINAL unless the governing lifecycle says otherwise.
DONE requires durable evidence/return according to the delegated-work contract.
STALE is derived only by declared stale policy, never from conversational silence.
unconsumed returns remain visible until a durable integration/consumption decision exists.

frontier_compilation.principle: Choose the highest-value safe durable frontier from governing objectives, gates, blockers, dependencies and current evidence; do not ask the human to reconstruct remembered plans.
priority_boundaries: real authority/consent/identity boundaries may require human action
otherwise prefer useful safe work that advances a gate or removes a blocker
active workers do not force the parent to idle
do not start shared-authority implementation when a required convergence gate is unresolved
Live/UI cosmetics remain after-core unless they directly unblock correctness
frontier_compilation.explainability: next_safe_action carries source/gate reasons so a successor can distinguish an executable frontier from a blocked one.

privacy_and_security: Public projection contains sanitized metadata only.
Credentials, capability tokens, raw sensitive transcripts and private payloads are never embedded.
A private source may contribute an allowed sanitized state fact without exporting its payload.
Compiler fails closed rather than merging incompatible privacy/export classifications.
failure_policy: Identity disagreement across root/chat/campaign sources => emit blocking conflict, do not guess latest.
Conflicting Current/owner/authority refs => fail closed and surface the conflict.
Dangling required recovery pointer => mark degraded/blocking according to scope, never silently omit.
Mixed-head or freshness ambiguity => re-read/recompile instead of composing an apparently current snapshot.
Private material selected for a public projection => compilation failure.

feature_flags.generic_worker_w_operational: false until Queue/Claim implementation plus collision/stale/recovery canaries pass

migration_plan: Keep current manual coordination/CONTINUITY_HEAD.json as recovery seed while compiler is candidate.
Implement compiler in shadow mode against the same durable sources.
Compare shadow output with manual head and source-derived truth across active campaigns/roots.
Resolve all material divergence and privacy/authority findings.
Only after full B-BIGPIC convergence and Steward acceptance move the canonical recovery pointer to compiler output.
Retain previous head identities for rollback/recovery.
required_falsification_tests: same source head produces deterministic semantic projection
fresh parent with no transcript reaches the same active frontier from compiled head
prepared job with no run is reported NOT_STARTED
RETURN without DONE is not falsely counted as terminal DONE
stale claim/run uses explicit stale policy and preserves attempt lineage
unconsumed return remains surfaced until integration receipt exists
root/project private context never leaks into another root or public head
source digest/head change forces projection refresh
mixed identity/current-owner inputs fail closed instead of newest-wins
derived counters can be rebuilt from zero without reading previous counters
shadow compiler remains equivalent to manually verified recovery state before canonical switch
parent-erasure test recovers active workers, returns, blockers and next safe frontier without human memory

promotion_gate: reconcile with final Architecture/Active Method vNext
Steward records promotion rationale and authority boundary
shadow parity and fresh-parent tests pass before replacing the manual seed
